info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Enterprise Service Fixed Asset Register-spec
info.description: The Fixed Asset Register Update API enables organizations to modify existing entries in their fixed asset register efficiently. This endpoint supports the updating of asset details including valuation, location, and associated financial data. It's intended for financial teams and asset managers who require accurate and up-to-date asset management records. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline asset maintenance processes and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

put.summary: Updates an existing fixed asset record.
put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a fixed asset within the register. All necessary fields must be included in the request to successfully modify an asset's information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the fixed asset register within the enterprise services. It requires a JSON payload that conforms to the defined schema, which includes various properties relevant to the fixed asset information. Please ensure that all required fields are populated appropriately.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
